identity_check: Confirmed as Nominal, Inc. at nominal.io (page title 'Nominal | The hardware intelligence platform'; footer 'Since 2022'), a data platform with AI agents for hardware test and evaluation. Its about page names co-founders Cameron McCord (CEO), Bryce Strauss and Jason Hoch, matching the 2024 stealth-exit release and Haystack's post. HQ city is unsettled: TechCrunch (2026-03-05) and SiliconANGLE call it Los Angeles-based, TechCrunch (2026-11-09) says Austin, Texas, and the about page lists offices in Los Angeles, New York, Austin, Seattle, Washington, D.C. and London without naming an HQ; the country is US either way. Not any of the unrelated companies that use the name 'Nominal' (for example finance or accounting software startups); confirmed by the nominal.io domain, the hardware test-data product and the named founders. Category adjacent, layer design_intent: Nominal sells a data platform plus AI agents ('Analyst') to hardware engineering teams for test and evaluation (telemetry, test stands, flight tests). That overlaps the hardware-team tooling half of Utopian Autonomy (requirements / design-intent tooling for hardware teams) but not its factory-floor agents for plant staff, the same reasoning that filed Vinci (simulation) as adjacent / design_intent. The two 2026 raises are separate rounds: an $80M Series B extension at a $1B valuation led by Founders Fund (March) and a $240M Series C at a $3B valuation led by Lightspeed Venture Partners and co-led by Insight Partners (November). The $71.2M AFWERX STRATFI award of October 2026 is a government contract, not equity, and is not recorded as a round.

company.name: Nominal
company.description: Data and AI-agent platform where hardware engineering teams capture, monitor and analyse test telemetry, used across aerospace, defense and energy.

layer_detail: Test and evaluation data for hardware programs: ingest, storage, search and video sync of telemetry; live monitoring of streaming channels during tests; procedures, monitors, trending and reports; the Analyst AI agent and investigations; MCP, API and SDKs (Python, MATLAB, LabVIEW, Rust and others) for custom tools, plus connected control of test hardware. Deploys in Nominal cloud, BYOC, AWS GovCloud, on-premises, air-gapped or disconnected; ITAR (U.S. only), NIST SP 800-171 and SOC 2 Type II.
product_summary: Data platform where hardware teams capture test telemetry and context, then analyse it live, run procedures, monitors, trending and reports, and build custom tools via SDKs, MCP and API. The Analyst AI agent helps engineers investigate data. Deploys in Nominal's cloud, customer cloud, GovCloud, on-premises or air-gapped.
